ideas.title: Investigation into FBI's Handling of Alex Pretti Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the FBI's handling of the Alex Pretti shooting, including their decision to decline sharing evidence with Minnesota officials.
questions: Why did the FBI decline to share evidence?
What are the implications of this decision for the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential wrongdoing or lack of transparency within the FBI, and highlight the need for greater accountability in federal investigations.
